method: Independent web opening of official documentation followed by fresh local RTB 1.4.4 execution; not acceptance of author assertions.

sources.supports: A1 uses triangulation; do not infer the mechanism or present-day specifications of every model from the lecture example.
Ordinary full-dimensional formula uses positive-definite covariance; singular handling uses a different support/pseudo-inverse convention.
q is a state property; step updates simulation state, while f/Fx/Fv support predicted-state and covariance calculations.
Ellipse default confidence is .95 and uses position covariance. Step computes measurement-minus-prediction and wraps bearing residual.
Scalar workspace A expands to [-A,A] on each axis; constructor can use deterministic seed.
RangeBearingSensor accepts deprecated animate alias with a warning, computes atan2-based relative bearing, uses the chain-rule pose Jacobian and returns measurement with feature ID.
